name: 文化停留资产
experience_value: Represents the type of stop that lets the route breathe through looking, reading, and reflecting rather than walking harder.
Useful for solo regeneration because it introduces a non-food, non-landmark pause with real narrative function.
Can be instantiated later as a museum, gallery, or bookstore-cafe node depending on final selector and map coverage.
avoid_when: the route is already too abstract and needs a concrete city-signature anchor instead
the traveler wants only outdoor movement and landmark coverage
the plan day is so compressed that a reflection stop would feel like an interruption rather than relief
